card.name: The word with after a condition name
card.fires_on: The word "with" (or "With") that links a condition to an added feature, as in "hepatomegaly with steatosis" or "rash with eosinophilia". It also fires on "With" before Video or Images in news headlines.

modes.label: Named syndromes
modes.description: "with" joins a drug-reaction or toxicity term to its accompanying finding.
modes.example: Lactic acidosis and hepatomegaly<< with>> steatosis, including fatal cases,

modes.label: Headline extras
modes.description: "With" marks attached media such as video or images in news listings.
modes.example: Fossils, mineral rocks attract huge crowds at expo (<<With>> Images)

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like "includes" and "include" and away from unrelated Chinese phrases and "reality".
card.plain: It fires on the word "with" when it links a condition to what comes with it, as in "hepatomegaly with steatosis", or marks attached media in headlines.
